warning a11y_consider_explicit_label 6:1-6:23 Buttons and links should either contain text or have an `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `title` attribute

warning element_invalid_self_closing_tag 6:1-6:23 Self-closing HTML tags for non-void elements are ambiguous — use `<button ...></button>` rather than `<button ... />`
    https://svelte.dev/e/element_invalid_self_closing_tag
